text:
mike: attempting promo v2026.05 -> staging, deploy-bot failed artifact validate step: metadata checksum mismatch. holding change window.
deploy-bot: ERROR artifact validate: cache-index checksum mismatch (expected=9f8b, got=7c3d). refusing to promote.
elaine: that's the cache index we rely on for dedupe. could be a partial GC or write race on storage.
peter: any recent GC jobs or pruner runs? infra-bot: yes, pruner started at 2026-03-23T18:05Z against shard-3. see incident link: https://internal/ops/incidents/PR-341
mike: if we promote anyway, risk running with inconsistent dedupe metadata -> potential missing files for later deploys. Not great.
release-manager: our change window ends 19:00Z. product expects this release but can tolerate a short delay if necessary.
elaine: options: 1) wait for shard repair (est. 20-30m) 2) manual-promote previous digest to meet window 3) force-validate by re-uploading artifact (slow). Thoughts?
peter: reupload likely to hit same pruner race. waiting for storage repair seems safest.
ops-oncall: I can pause pruner on shard-3 and trigger metadata reconciliation, but it might take ~15m. If we pause now and reconcile, we can retry promotion.
mike: suggestion: pause pruner, attempt reconcile + guarded retry for 20m. if still mismatch -> manual-promote previous digest and open hotfix backlog ticket.
release-manager: +1. document in release notes if we promote previous. product ok with that contingency.
infra-bot: action: pausing pruner job id=pr-341 now. starting reconcile task.
deploy-bot: revalidate attempt queued (attempt=1)
ops-oncall: update 10m: reconcile progressed, checksum for cache-index updated to expected value on most nodes, but two replicas lagging.
elaine: partial heal but still risk. how much time until all replicas consistent?
ops-oncall: estimate 12-15m.
release-manager: time check: 18:25Z, 35m left in window. Proposal: continue recon for 15m, if still failing at 18:40Z -> manual-promote previous digest.
mike: agree. we'll prepare release notes wording and hotfix ticket now.
release-manager: drafting release notes: "Release to staging delayed due to cache metadata drift during storage pruning; previous build will be promoted to preserve schedule. Fix to follow in hotfix once metadata reconcile completes."
peter: reconcile done at 18:38Z; one final revalidate in progress.
deploy-bot: final validate: SUCCESS. artifact promote proceeding.
release-manager: good — promoting v2026.05 now: `deployctl promote --from=canary --to=staging --version=v2026.05`
deploy-bot: promote accepted, audit id=prom-3502-01, staging now at v2026.05.
ops-oncall: resuming pruner with adjusted throttle to avoid overlap with deploy windows. created follow-up ticket: TICKET-912 (investigate pruner race and add pre-deploy quiesce).
release-manager: closing hold at 18:45Z. posting update to #release-updates and assigning postmortem owner.
infra-bot: incident INC-2026-0421 opened for cache-pruner race and resolved with mitigation steps.
